name: moveTo
doc: when user asks you to move to a specific spot or environment object in the world, use this action. The parameter is the name of the spot or environment object

name: moveToPoint
args: x: float, y: float, z: float
doc: when the user asks you to go to an arbitrary point in the world, use this action. The parameters are the x, y, and z coordinates of the point.

name: talk
doc: use this action when the user asks you something or where a comment to some other action is appropriate. The parameter is the text you want to say.

name: grab
doc: Pick up a named object from the environment. Precondition: itemInRightHand must be empty (no item held). If itemInRightHand already has a value, do not grab again, use the held item directly. Always moveTo the object first. Only one item can be held at a time.

name: place
doc: Put down the currently held item onto the named environment object. Precondition: itemInRightHand must be non-empty, this is what makes place valid. If itemInRightHand is empty, there is nothing to place, use talk to explain instead. Always moveTo the target object first.
